_about: The story's opening, a beat at a time (scripts/story.gd runs it on a new game). Each beat: id, objective (the card's title), hint (how to do it), guide (true: the starter guide, its card over her head; the story's own, at the right under the map), parts (optional: [text, what does it], shown after the hint and lit up as she does each: walk, run, jump, strike, cast (a skill), eat, sleep, have:Thing:n, built:Prop, stored:Thing:n; {progress} in its text shows how far along, 3/10), start (what happens as it begins), done (what ends it), after (what happens as it ends). start/after actions: {do: spawn, what: slime|boar|mutatedVillager, count, near (units from Sera)}, {do: give, what, n}, {do: time, hour}, {do: clock, run: true|false}, {do: wake}, {do: messenger}, {do: mist_in}, {do: attack, count}, {do: ward}, {do: record, event}, {do: say, text}. done kinds: walked (units), killed (what, count: since the beat began), opened (character|talents), have (what: {resource: n} in her bag), built (what: [props], in_village), cooked (count of dishes cooked, since the beat began), slept, scene (id), reach_village, raid_over, stored (what: {resource: n} more in storage), houses (min condition), stored_dishes (count), morning.

parts: W A S D to walk

beats.hint: Something's come out of the mist.
More slimes along the road. Your skills are on the bar below:
parts: 1 to aim Fireball, click where it lands

beats.hint: I opens your bag and your character.
P opens your talents. Spend a point when you have one.
E by a tree to chop, by a rock to mine.
A boar in the trees, and slimes. Boar meat can be cooked.
At the lit bonfire, hold E with raw meat in your bag.

parts: Z by your bed to sleep

beats.hint: Up the road north, then east to the houses. Hurry.
They're everywhere. Protect who you can.
The mist's in the village. B: place a Cleansing Crystal among the houses.
The elder is with them. E to talk.
Walls are down all over. Put in a chest, for the villagers to rebuild with:
The villagers are rebuilding the walls and mending the houses. Lend a hand gathering if they run short.
There's a bed for you in the village tonight. Z to sleep.

after.text: Morning. The elder looks like he hasn't slept.
